name: job-search
description: Find current job openings that match the user's role, location and skills, and save a shortlist to Excel.

name: resume-tailor
description: Tailor a resume and write a short cover letter for a specific job posting, keeping everything truthful.

name: code-explainer
description: Explain code, an error message or a stack trace in plain language, find the likely cause, and suggest a fix.

name: trip-planner
description: Plan a trip day by day (places, timing, travel between them, rough budget), using live web search, and save it as a PDF.

name: expense-tracker
description: Build an Excel expense tracker with categories, monthly totals and a budget-vs-actual summary, optionally filled from pasted transactions.

name: daily-planner
description: Turn a to-do list into a realistic plan for today with time blocks, priorities and breaks.

name: research-report
description: Research a question across several sources and write a sourced report (summary, findings, comparison table, links) as a PDF or Word file.

name: flashcards
description: Make study flashcards and a short quiz from notes, a PDF, a web page or the video being watched.

name: meeting-notes
description: Turn a messy meeting transcript, recording summary or rough notes into clean notes with decisions, action items and owners, saved as a Word file.

name: email-writer
description: Draft a clear email or reply in the right tone (formal, friendly, firm), from a few words of intent or the email being answered.
